plugins.Author: yagi2
plugins.Name: RepeatBuy
plugins.Punchline: Repeat-buy items from NPC shops with stop conditions.
plugins.Description: Embeds a small overlay next to the standard NPC Shop window. Pick an item from the mirrored shop list, choose a stop condition (fixed count >99 OK, until owned, gil floor, inventory full), and the plugin handles the repeat purchases for you. Shows an estimated total cost popup before starting and warns in red if you cannot afford it. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO).

plugins.Author: yagi2
plugins.Name: Restocker
plugins.Punchline: Bulk reprice and split-list retainer market listings across all retainers.
plugins.Description: Cross-retainer market workbench with a plan-then-apply flow. Reprice tab: per-retainer 'lowest -N g' / 'lowest exact' buttons walk each listing, fetch live market data via Dalamud's IMarketBoard.OfferingsReceived (skipping your own retainers, deduplicated per item/HQ), stage every change in a queue, then commit them all via a single Apply that calls SetRetainerMarketPrice directly. New listing tab: per-row qty x slots, target retainer combo, auto stack-splitting (e.g. 990 / 99 → ten listings of 99), and direct listing from character bag / Chocobo Saddlebag with no entrust step (saddle items are bulk-staged to the bag in one phase, then listed). Live progress dialog shows the current step (selecting retainer, fetching market data, listing, …) so long runs don't look frozen. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO). Warns once at startup if AutoRetainer is also loaded since both drive retainer summoning.

plugins.Author: yagi2
plugins.Name: GilDelta
plugins.Punchline: Track gil flow across self, retainers, and FC chest.
plugins.Description: An always-on gil tracker for FFXIV. Watches your own gil, every retainer, and the FC chest, classifies each change (submarine return, retainer sale, NPC purchase, marketboard buy, repair, etc.), and surfaces the flow through a configurable widget (4 density modes) and a dashboard (timeline / chart / breakdown / heatmap). Read-only — never writes back to game state. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO).
